note: Triennial election of the rural district council (ten electoral divisions), 1952: no contest; S. J. Foye, clerk and returning officer, declared the ten members elected. Returned unopposed. New member. Chosen as the official Unionist candidate by the local branch of North Armagh Unionist Association (Portadown Times, 23 May 1952, p. 6).
